name: Your Hero, Jayce Blackwood
source:
"My name is Jayce.
And for some reason, you don't remember me.
You don't remember the [s]HERO[/s] who saved you.
We only met for one night, not even a full hour, but that brief exchange was everything to me.
I can't wait until you recognize me.
Until you love me like I love you."

Your Hero, Jayce Blackwood is A DARK EROTICA, with twisted romance, pining, yearning and adoration, a wicked combination of cute, fluffy moments and sexually charged, obsessive desperation.

translation:
“我叫杰斯。
但出于某种原因，你不记得我了。
你不记得救了你的[s]HERO[/s]。
我们只见面了一晚，甚至不到一小时，但那次短暂的交流对我来说就是一切。
我等不及你认出我了。
直到你像我爱你一样爱我。”

你的英雄杰斯·布莱克伍德是一部黑暗情色小说，充满了扭曲的浪漫、渴望、渴望和崇拜，是可爱、毛茸茸的时刻和充满性欲的、痴迷的绝望的邪恶组合。
